regions.name: Clavicular head
regions.description: The upper portion of the pectoralis major assists shoulder flexion. An incline press changes the angle of load and emphasizes this region.
regions.note: Incline pressing emphasizes the upper chest; both chest regions contribute.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Set a low incline, around 15–30°. Start with dumbbells beside your upper chest. Press upward and slightly inward, then lower with control.
exercises.cue: Keep your shoulders supported; avoid shrugging at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.instructions: Plant your feet, keep your shoulder blades supported on the bench, and grip just wider than shoulder width. Lower the bar under control to your mid-chest, then press up.
exercises.cue: Keep wrists stacked over elbows. Use a spotter or safety arms.

regions.name: Sternocostal head
regions.description: The broad middle and lower portion draws your arm across your chest. Flat presses and fly variations load this region alongside the rest of the chest.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.instructions: Plant your feet, keep your shoulder blades supported on the bench, and grip just wider than shoulder width. Lower the bar under control to your mid-chest, then press up.
exercises.cue: Keep wrists stacked over elbows. Use a spotter or safety arms.

exercises.name: Cable chest fly
exercises.instructions: Stand in a split stance between two pulleys. With a soft bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Move through the shoulder and keep the elbow angle steady.

regions.name: Pectoralis minor
regions.description: A deeper muscle beneath the pectoralis major that moves and stabilizes the shoulder blade.
regions.note: Trains scapular protraction with serratus anterior; does not isolate pectoralis minor.

exercises.name: Incline push-up plus
exercises.instructions: Place your hands on a stable bench. Perform a controlled push-up. At the top, keep your elbows straight and push the bench away so your shoulder blades move around your ribs.
exercises.cue: Keep your trunk steady; let the shoulder blades move without shrugging.

regions.name: Serratus anterior
regions.description: Attaches along the side of the ribs and holds the shoulder blade against the thorax.

exercises.name: Incline push-up plus
exercises.instructions: Place your hands on a stable bench. Perform a controlled push-up. At the top, keep your elbows straight and push the bench away so your shoulder blades move around your ribs.
exercises.cue: Keep your trunk steady; let the shoulder blades move without shrugging.

exercises.name: Forearm wall slide
exercises.instructions: Place your forearms against a wall. Slide them upward as you gently reach into the wall, then return.
exercises.cue: Allow the shoulder blades to rotate; keep your ribs controlled.
